Audio System Outline
As the audio system, the 6-speaker system combining 6 speakers with the HDD navigation or the AM/FM electronic tuner with odd-size CD player continues to be used, and the AM/FM electronic tuner with odd-size in-dash CD changer has been discontinued.
The HDD navigation has been changed from the 05 model year specification to the 09 model year specification.
USB and AUX mini jack terminals have been newly adopted as external input terminals for the HDD navigation.
